title: Tariff component record
description: One line of a utility's published tariff table (e.g. a demand or energy charge for a customer group and time slot), in the source's units. Values are copied from the source; missing values are null.

modality.description: Tariff modality, e.g. Azul, Verde, Convencional, Branca.

detail.description: Source qualifier, e.g. SCEE (net metering), APE (self-producer).

time_slot.description: e.g. Ponta, Fora ponta, Intermediário; null when the line has none.

tusd.description: Distribution system use charge (TUSD). Negative for credits (e.g. SCEE net-metering lines).

resolution.description: The regulatory act that set this tariff.

total_with_assumed_taxes.description: total with taxes added at the assumed rates given in the dataset's source.notes. Not published by the source.
